Name: Vibrant Pastoral Zuzu
Author: PixieTJ
Description:
I needed a recolor to fit with Vibrant Pastoral, or any of the more natural recolors, and couldn't find any, so here it is. Now walking into Zuzu won't be such a color shock compared to the rest of Stardew, phew!

This is meant to compliment Vibrant Pastoral Recolor, but will also work well for DaisyNiko's Earth Recolor, as the two are closer than the default would be.

Let me know if you see any glaring errors and I'll do my best to fix it. I still can't figure out how to get Zuzu to read my content.json so no manifest still. //rant

Downloads.Description:
Let it overwrite Zuzu, or alternatively use a mod manager.
